dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five primary 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible on the upper dorsal region. The most prominent superior annulus exhibits a dark perimeter (approx. 8-12 pixels wide) with a high-contrast gradient to a light-grey core. Smaller annuli display fragmented, jagged edge geometries on their posterior boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of low-intensity dark pixel clusters is concentrated in the posterior-dorsal region. Localized, solid high-intensity light-grey blobs are sparsely distributed across the anterior-lateral flank, lacking any internal radial gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle. The longest segment of the triangle is oriented longitudinally, with the obtuse vertex located at the central-most annulus centroid.
